item.title: MSG & EML Email Viewer — Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: 2 July 2026

TL;DR — Everything happens locally in your browser. The extension does not collect, transmit, sell, or share any data. No analytics, no tracking, no servers operated by the developer.

What the extension does

MSG & EML Email Viewer intercepts .msg and .eml email file downloads from sites you configure and opens them in a built-in viewer instead of saving them to disk. To do this, it:
